commit.message: fix(mission-control): close Fleet owner PR gates

interface_mismatches: Mission Control exposes an exact configured-mission snapshot but no ratified complete fleet enumeration contract.
Fleet Hub must consume the existing TaskBoard and RuntimeStateStore owner instances; opening, copying, or shadowing their databases would split authority.
Recorded attempts, leases, heartbeats, acknowledgements, and replaceable runtime receipts do not prove a live executor or external effect.
TaskBoard has no atomic expected-version mutation contract, so this pull request exposes no Fleet command path.
The configured provider is a bounded read adapter and the committed-range packet is CI scope evidence; neither is human approval or production qualification.
honest_blockers: This pull request does not select or create a production mission and does not prove a live Mission Control session exists on Meghadharma.
This pull request does not deploy, alter live owner state, authorize commands, mutate NATS or ACLs, or claim production promotion.
A private owner-instance seam remains confined to the API composition root and fails closed until SwarmManager exposes a ratified public accessor.
This packet covers the committed PR range and cannot truthfully attest that the two earlier implementation commits were preflighted under this exact final packet.
session_entry.rollback: Revert the PR 1471 commits. No TaskBoard, RuntimeStateStore, NATS, credential, ACL, daemon, deployment, or live owner data is mutated by the bounded read path.
